name: status
description: Worker status packet result.
validation: Truth table: DONE => completed plus verdict=clean and no must-fix/should-fix findings; DONE_WITH_CONCERNS => completed plus verdict has_must_fix, has_should_fix, or has_nits_only and at least one finding; NEEDS_CONTEXT => needs_context plus verdict=not_assessed and no findings; BLOCKED => blocked plus verdict=not_assessed and no findings.

name: round
description: Echo back the round number for tracking

name: batch_id
description: Echo back the frozen review batch identifier

name: review_snapshot_id
description: Echo back the frozen snapshot identifier

name: snapshot_identity
description: Echo back the complete frozen snapshot identity, including the scope_manifest digest

object_fields.name: scope_manifest_digest
object_fields.description: Digest of the ordered scope_manifest and its content digests

name: review_pass_id
description: Echo back the independent pass identifier

name: review_attempt_id
description: Echo back the active dispatch attempt identifier.

name: review_perspective
description: Echo back the pass perspective

name: pass_completion_state
description: Reviewer-owned completion report. Truth table is enforced with status, verdict, findings, coverage_entries, and open_questions. The orchestrator maps it to ledger terminal_state; only the orchestrator records timed_out, failed, or invalidated lifecycle failures.

name: reviewed_scope
description: Files, diffs, task packets, slices, or content boundaries actually inspected in this review round

name: findings
description: All evidence-backed findings that satisfy the finding_filter_policy for this round; empty only for DONE clean or NEEDS_CONTEXT/BLOCKED not_assessed returns.

object_fields.name: file
object_fields.validation: Must be a file path covered by the reviewed material, or a stable content label when reviewing pasted content

object_fields.name: line
object_fields.description: Line number in the file (not the diff line number)

object_fields.name: description
object_fields.validation: Specific and actionable — not vague ('could be better')

object_fields.name: confidence_pct
object_fields.validation: Evidence-calibrated confidence value; used for evidence-calibrated explanation with the same standards at every ordinal

object_fields.name: suggestion
object_fields.description: Concrete fix suggestion when applicable

object_fields.name: finding_id
object_fields.description: Stable source finding identifier in the review_pass_id namespace for deterministic aggregation.
object_fields.validation: Unique within this Reviewer return and in the review_pass_id namespace.

object_fields.name: locus
object_fields.description: Concrete affected location or behavior boundary used for conservative aggregation

object_fields.name: invariant
object_fields.description: Broken contract or behavior that the finding demonstrates

object_fields.name: failure_mechanism
object_fields.description: How the evidence causes the invariant to fail; prose similarity is insufficient

object_fields.name: evidence
object_fields.description: Concrete source or execution evidence for this finding

object_fields.name: smallest_useful_fix
object_fields.description: Smallest durable corrective change; suggestion remains a compatibility alias

name: coverage_entries
description: Pass-level coverage evidence. A clean local pass still records what it inspected.

object_fields.name: scope_item_id
object_fields.validation: Belongs to this pass assigned_scope and review_material_snapshot.scope_manifest.

object_fields.name: applicable_concern
object_fields.validation: Belongs to scope_item_id applicable_concerns in review_material_snapshot.scope_manifest.

object_fields.name: review_perspective
object_fields.validation: Equals this pass review_perspective and one required_coverage_tuples member.

object_fields.name: coverage_obligation
object_fields.validation: Must be one of this pass coverage_obligations and a required_coverage_tuples member.

object_fields.name: status
object_fields.validation: Only inspected_no_risk or finding completes a required tuple. blocked creates incomplete coverage; not_applicable is invalid for a generated required tuple.

object_fields.name: finding_ids
object_fields.validation: Every id links to a retained actionable finding. A schema-invalid return creates a coverage gap and incomplete coverage; it cannot discard a validated finding.

name: closure_results
validation: Exact equality with pending previously_fixed IDs; preserve their source IDs/provenance. Missing, incomplete, or regressed IDs remain findings and block CLEAN.

name: observations
description: Speculative or low-evidence concerns that do not block completion

name: summary
description: Pass-level summary for only the assigned scope; it cannot imply batch cleanliness or the final review result.
validation: Non-empty. Must reference specific patterns observed, not generic praise. When no must-fix or should-fix finding exists, use 'No material findings within the reviewed scope and available evidence' rather than presenting clean as proof of correctness.

name: evidence
description: Review material, files, searches, or checks used to support findings and verdict

name: agentic_loop_safety_checks
description: Compact confirmation that agentic loop safety review was applied

object_fields.name: bounded_execution
object_fields.description: Whether framework semantic work shares the task guard and application/tool/API loops retain appropriate explicit user/product/resource bounds

object_fields.name: stop_condition
object_fields.description: Whether success, budget, blocker, and escalation exits are explicit

object_fields.name: retry_and_empty_result_handling
object_fields.description: Whether semantic correction retains the shared guard and transient tool/API retries and empty results follow their operational policy

object_fields.name: tool_error_handling
object_fields.description: Whether tool/API failures route to retry, fallback, blocker, or degraded result

object_fields.name: progress_and_stagnation_detection
object_fields.description: Whether repeated iterations require progress and handle stagnation

object_fields.name: cost_token_guardrails
object_fields.description: Whether paid API/model/subagent/large-context loops have budget awareness

object_fields.name: low_confidence_escalation
object_fields.description: Whether insufficient evidence, uncertain outcomes, or low confidence route to escalation, fallback, BLOCKED, or degraded result instead of claiming success

name: behavioral_contract_checks
description: Compact confirmation that behavioral contract review was applied

object_fields.name: existing_behavior_and_invariants
object_fields.description: Whether existing behavior, invariants, compatibility assumptions, and edge cases still hold

object_fields.name: interface_implementation_alignment
object_fields.description: Whether public APIs, DTOs, schemas, docs/examples, config, generated clients, and implementation agree

object_fields.name: test_inheritance_coverage
object_fields.description: Whether tests cover inherited behavior plus new behavior and cannot pass a fake/incomplete implementation

object_fields.name: protocol_algorithm_fidelity
object_fields.description: Whether known protocol/algorithm/business-rule semantics are preserved or not applicable

object_fields.name: high_impact_operation_guards
object_fields.description: Whether money/auth/data deletion/privacy/safety/production-impact paths have appropriate guardrails or not applicable

object_fields.name: runtime_surface_sync
object_fields.description: Whether code/tests/docs/config/migrations/generated clients/deploy/runbook surfaces are synced or not applicable

name: semantic_contract_checks
description: Compact confirmation that semantic contract review was applied

object_fields.name: inherited_contract_obligations
object_fields.description: Whether method/template outputs satisfy inherited base contracts or condition them explicitly

object_fields.name: template_contract_alignment
object_fields.description: Whether SKILL.md/templates/contracts/phase gates/handoffs/references name consistent artifacts

object_fields.name: eval_inheritance_coverage
object_fields.description: Whether evals require both new behavior and inherited base artifacts

object_fields.name: external_method_signature_fidelity
object_fields.description: Whether named-method adaptations preserve the defining loop or mark not applicable

object_fields.name: high_stakes_recommendation_guard
object_fields.description: Whether high-stakes recommendation paths have appropriate guardrails or are not applicable

object_fields.name: mirror_surface_sync
object_fields.description: Whether root/generated/docs/automation surfaces that can drive behavior are synced or not applicable

name: architecture_decision_pack_checks
description: Compact confirmation that Architecture Decision Pack review was applied

name: principle_checks
condition: quality_principles_required is true or scope_size in [medium, large]
description: Compact confirmation that the clean-code principle lens was applied; medium+ includes the Design Coherence Pass

object_fields.name: solid
object_fields.description: SOLID observations or 'no concrete risk found'

object_fields.name: kiss
object_fields.description: KISS observations or 'no concrete risk found'

object_fields.name: dry
object_fields.description: DRY observations or 'no concrete risk found'

object_fields.name: yagni
object_fields.description: YAGNI observations or 'no concrete risk found'

object_fields.name: readability
object_fields.description: Readability observations or 'no concrete risk found'

object_fields.name: design_coherence
object_fields.description: Affected responsibility/boundary assessment with an evidence-backed risk or 'no concrete risk found'

name: reuse_search
description: Bounded existing-capability search and reuse decision for rule-like changes; not_applicable records a concrete reason without search ceremony
validation: When applicability=applicable, searches must be non-empty and candidates must be present or no_candidate_reason must be non-empty; decision and decision_rationale are required. An applicable review cannot return clean without this evidence.

object_fields.name: no_candidate_reason
object_fields.condition: applicability == applicable and candidates is empty

name: verdict
description: pass-level verdict for this assigned scope only; it cannot imply batch cleanliness or the final review result.
validation: clean: findings is empty or contains only items below threshold. has_must_fix: at least one finding with severity=must-fix. has_should_fix: no must-fix, but at least one should-fix. has_nits_only: only nit-level findings. not_assessed: status is NEEDS_CONTEXT or BLOCKED, pass_completion_state matches it, and findings is empty.

name: open_questions
description: Questions or blocker details the orchestrator must resolve

name: rubric_scores
condition: rubric_required is true (default for medium+ scope)
description: Structured rubric scores per references/review-rubric.md

object_fields.name: weighted_score
object_fields.validation: Calculated per rubric formula. Must match dimension * weight sum.

object_fields.name: action
object_fields.validation: Determined by weighted_score vs threshold for current round

object_fields.name: score_justification
object_fields.description: Per-dimension justification citing specific code

object_fields.name: critical_override
object_fields.description: If a critical finding caps the score, describe it here

name: pivot_restart_signal
condition: the shared task guard reports genuine semantic stagnation or a material change needs a decision
description: Signal that the review loop needs orchestrator-owned pivot/restart handling before another fix/review dispatch.

object_fields.name: recommended_recovery_focus
object_fields.description: Lowest-scoring dimensions, stale-context concern, or blocker evidence the orchestrator should consider
